title: Google tests buying from Walmart-owned Flipkart through Gemini and AI Mode in India
slides: Google wants to buy your groceries?
Gemini now connects to Flipkart in India
But it skips the Flipkart app entirely
Your shopping cart just became conversational
Ask your assistant to order tonight
thread_text:
1. Google wants your groceries?

Google is integrating Gemini directly with Flipkart in India, letting you shop without ever opening the app.

2. Flipkart app skipped entirely

Gemini connects to Flipkart's backend, so you never see the storefront. Your cart becomes a chat window.

3. Your cart goes conversational

Instead of browsing, you just tell Gemini what you need. It adds items, compares prices, and checks out for you.

4. Ask assistant to order tonight

Say 'order my usual groceries' and Gemini handles it. No taps, no scrolling — just a confirmation.

5. Try it with one item

Open Gemini and ask it to find a product on Flipkart. If it works, you've just skipped the app forever. If not, tell me why.

instagram.caption:
In India you can now buy groceries on Flipkart without opening Flipkart.

Google is testing Gemini and AI Mode with Flipkart, so the assistant talks straight to the store's backend. No storefront, no app.

You just say "order my usual groceries" and it adds items, compares prices and checks out. 🤖

If you sell or advertise products online, the shelf you spent hours designing may never be seen — the assistant picks, not the shopper. 🛒

Would you hand your weekly shopping list to a chatbot, or do you want to see the cart before you pay? 🧾
